messages:
anna: Heads up — main CI is red after the merge from #1234. Failing step: container-validate.
anna: Short log:
```
+ docker build -t app:staging .
2026-03-17T14:02:21Z: ERROR: failed to set permissions on /app/node_modules: chmod /var/lib/docker/...: operation not permitted
``` 
anna: Anyone owning the container checks? pinging @devon since you touched the Dockerfile earlier.
devon: On it. I didn't see permission changes in my diff though. Pulling logs.
maria: Could be base image update? The merge included an image bump from node:18-alpine -> node:18.15-slim.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by @anna: `/ci rerun 2356789012 --step=container-validate`
ci-bot: Rerun queued (job 2356789111).
sre-bot: Notifying on-call infra for potential flake on build agents.
oliver: If rerun fails, we should bisect the range between commits abc123..def456 (the merge range).
devon: Rerun finished — still failing with same chmod error.
devon: I can take an initial bisect; will start with `git bisect` across abc123..def456 and update here.
anna: Thanks — if this is widespread we should consider temporarily gating merges until a fix.
maria: FYI I can try reproducing locally with the slim image.
ci-bot: Job 2356789145 completed: container-validate failed (exit 1).
devon: Found a suspect commit: def789 changed Docker build context and adds `chown` to a path that may be root-owned in CI. Trying a quick patch to chown only if exists.
anna: If devon needs an expedited PR review, I can take it.
devon: Opening PR with fix, will link once ready.
anna: Creating a short incident note in #incidents in case rollout is needed.
